title: Cell facts v1
description: units/cells/<cell>.json (D-067, D-060, plan v3 U1): what a bounded context declares about itself. The context map, CONTEXTS.md and the architecture checks are generated from these files joined with the unit manifests (scripts/generate context-map); no pull request writes the joined map. A cell file is a fact of one cell, so two lanes never edit the same file. The cell must be the `cell` of at least one unit manifest.

cell.description: The cell; equals the file name and the `cell` of its unit manifests.

order.description: Position in the generated map and documents; unique across cells.

budget.description: Shrink-only override of aggregates.context_files_ceiling and aggregates.context_lines_ceiling (D-060, L3.context-size).

concepts.description: The CONTRACT.md concepts the context owns (D-061).

dependsOn.description: The contexts it may import, through their application or domain ring; the graph is acyclic.

tables.description: The tables its translator platform/db/<context>/ owns.
